{{Top|leg}}
The '''hook of bone''' was a device used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to implant an individual with [[Yorik-Kul|slave coral]]. Ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vergere]] used a hook of bone in an attempt to implant a slave seed in [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] chest. However, the seed fell off the hook and slithered away.
